name: manual_db045b
claim: A passing order test proves input ordering only when completion ordering differs: delay the first async input, keep a serial control, and require the test to kill an as_completed mutant for concurrent limits. Dependency-free exporter stubs prove wiring; separately run pinned real upstream oracles before claiming interoperability.

decisions.notes: Greptile P2 on Core #8 was valid. Its revised test rejects a completion-order mutation at None, 2 and 100 while limit 1 remains serial; the mutation harness restores methods without changing source files. Core's ConditionalEdge declared_targets/path_map repair is covered by a mandatory stub plus a real LangGraph 1.0.3 execution oracle. Fake topology evidence does not establish scheduler parity.
